parameters.query:
-- Adapt table/column names to your Prisma schema before activating.
SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS employee_name, s.skill_name, s.current_level, s.required_level FROM users u JOIN employee_skills s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE COALESCE(s.current_level, 0) < COALESCE(s.required_level, 0) ORDER BY u.id, s.skill_name;

parameters.jsCode: const catalog=[{keywords:['python','data','ai','machine learning'],course:'Python & AI fundamentals',providers:['Coursera','Udemy'],url:'https://www.coursera.org/'},{keywords:['cloud','docker','devops','kubernetes'],course:'Docker and DevOps fundamentals',providers:['Coursera','Udemy'],url:'https://www.udemy.com/'},{keywords:['communication','leadership','teamwork'],course:'Communication and leadership',providers:['Coursera','Udemy'],url:'https://www.coursera.org/'},{keywords:['sql','database','postgres'],course:'SQL and database management',providers:['Coursera','Udemy'],url:'https://www.udemy.com/'}]; return $input.all().map(({json:r})=>{const skill=String(r.skill_name||'').toLowerCase();const match=catalog.find(c=>c.keywords.some(k=>skill.includes(k)));return {json:{...r,skill_gap:Math.max(0,Number(r.required_level||0)-Number(r.current_level||0)),recommended_course:match?.course||`Learning path: ${r.skill_name}`,providers:match?.providers||['Coursera','Udemy'],course_url:match?.url||'https://www.coursera.org/'}};});
